title: Audi defends plans for a $4 billion Georgia plant amid VW restructuring, tariffs
summary_full: Audi's CEO defended the company's plans for a $4 billion plant in Georgia, calling it a business decision to grow sales and reduce exposure to U.S. tariffs.
